lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: These streets aren't safe at night. Watch yourself.

lines.speaker: Merchant
lines.text: Welcome, traveler! Care to see my wares?

lines.speaker: Merchant
lines.text: I have the finest goods in all the land!

lines.speaker: Sign
lines.text: Welcome to Darkwood Village. Population: Dwindling.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: The chest is locked. You need a key.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: You found a Health Potion! Press Q to use it.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.text: Ah, a new face. We don't get many visitors these days.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.text: The undead have been growing bolder. Be careful out there.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.text: If you're brave enough, we could use your help clearing them out.

lines.speaker: Tutorial
lines.text: Use WASD to move around. Press SPACE to jump.

lines.speaker: Tutorial
lines.text: Left click to attack. Press H to toggle collision debug view.
